metadata.datasource:
Film data: KODAK VISION2 500T Color Negative Film 5260/7260 technical data (H-1-5260t, 2008), digitized by PoLUT (GPL-3.0) kodak_mp spec. Original data are property of Eastman Kodak. Processing: Built by the spektrafilm.exe fork from Kodak datasheet motionpicture/kodak/5260-Vision2-500T.pdf (digitized with PoLUT, GPL-3.0), processed with Andrea Volpato's published profile factory (March 2026, GPL-3.0) re-implemented in this repo. hanatos2025 adaptation parameters and the non-spectral profile structure are inherited from kodak_vision3_500t (spektrafilm profile by Andrea Volpato, CC BY-SA 4.0). This is a derivative work, not an upstream profile. Density curves then corrected with Andrea Volpato's published grey-ramp algorithm (profiles_factory/correct.py, March 2026) run through this app's pipeline on kodak_2383, data_trustability=0.3. Status M densitometer responses from the spektrafilm repository.
    RMS granularity 12.3 DERIVED for ISO 500 from the cine curve rms = 2.36 x ISO^0.266 (R2 0.81, n 4) because its sheet publishes none (no_sheet); typical error of a derived value is about 20%. Embedded 2026-09-21.
